Binance Resumes Crypto Withdrawals After $6.3 Billion Heist

Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has resumed withdrawals for 15 cryptocurrencies after a heist that saw approximately $6.3 billion stolen. The exchange stated it used its own funds to cover about 95% of the stolen assets. Following the resumption of withdrawals, Binance saw net outflows of $3.64 billion. The FBI has blamed North Korea for the hack, which is described as the biggest crypto heist in history.
